scope: Pinned curated selections only; this is not a whole-suite support claim.

status_definitions.native-supported: A Drove-native declaration, assertion, class, or runtime equivalent exists in this revision.
status_definitions.pending: The pinned selection uses the construct and still needs native migration or corpus proof.
status_definitions.rejected: The current native surface deliberately rejects the construct; keeping the selected path creates an explicit completion conflict.

migration_readiness_definition: Static source readiness after the corpus-specific Drove migrator applies its deterministic codemods. A blocker-free file has no Scanner/Migrator blocker after that pass; this is not execution-parity evidence.

surfaces.native_target: Drove native class frontend plus an explicit environment

raw_source_migration_surfaces_definition: Raw pinned-source constructs not marked native-supported before corpus-specific codemods; non-zero counts are migration input, not failed native execution gates.

raw_source_migration_surfaces.proof_target: Every selected expectation construct is native-supported or has an explicitly accepted rejection.
All 288 cases run through the native class frontend without PHPUnit runBare or Testbench lifecycle bridging.
All 202 cases use native Laravel context and prepared state without Pest Laravel or Laravel TestCase binding.
All 705 cases preserve the serial split and run without Pest/Testbench bridges.
Either implement each rejected construct used by a selected path or explicitly revise the pinned cohort contract.
